note: Routine mail placed before the target email (one or two per episode). Researcher-authored; not on the drive. Varied on purpose: schedule questions, thanks, an FYI, a follow-up, an opinion, a complaint, requests for the right contact, an invitation. None touches a scenario topic (no ditches or culverts, trash or recycling, the Hotchkiss crushing yard or zoning notices, Fillmore Park or playgrounds, fire staffing or response). The bulk agent should make sure ordinary drive files answer them: office hours and the supervisor's Tuesday office hours, leaf pickup dates, trick-or-treat hours, the absentee drop box and Election Day hours, shed permits, golf carts on township roads, Bay County DWS for water bills, the Road Commission for potholes, winter tax bill timing, blight enforcement, the senior club and Lions invitations, the HHW day.

emails.name: Diane Kosecki
emails.body:
Hi, is the township office open on Fridays? And I read somewhere the new supervisor has office hours for residents, what day is that? I'd like to stop in about a few things but I work until 2.

Thanks, Diane

emails.name: Roger Pelkey
emails.body:
Just a note to say the hazardous waste day Saturday was very well run. I had 20 years of old paint cans and stain in the garage and the guys had me in and out in 5 minutes. Please keep doing it every year.

Roger Pelkey

emails.name: Sue Ann Dziedzic
emails.body: When does leaf pickup start this year and do the leaves go in bags or at the curb? We have three big maples and they are coming down fast. Last year I put them in bags and they sat there.

emails.name: Jessica Rivard
emails.body: What are the trick or treat hours for the township this year? Is it on Halloween night or a different day since it's a Saturday? Thank you!

emails.name: Walter Brzezinski
emails.body:
I have my absentee ballot filled out. Is there a drop box at the township hall or do I have to mail it? I don't trust the mail this close. Also what time do the polls close on the 3rd in case my wife decides to go in person.

Walt

emails.name: Brian Lesniak
emails.body:
I'm buying a 10x12 shed from a dealer that delivers it already built. Do I need a permit from the township for that or only if I build it myself? And how far from the lot line does it have to be?

Thanks
Brian

emails.name: Frank Okonski
emails.body:
Mr. Seidlitz, a lot of us older folks in the subdivisions would like to be able to drive golf carts to the neighbors and to the park. Other townships allow it. I emailed the office last week and haven't heard. Can the township allow golf carts on our streets? I'd like you to support it.

Frank Okonski

emails.name: Debra Lutz
emails.body: My water bill is way higher than usual and I can't find any leaks. Who do I call about that? Is that still the township? I called the number on the old bill and nobody answered.

emails.name: Kevin Szczepanski
emails.body: There is a pothole on Scheurmann just west of Ledyard that is going to take somebody's tire off. It's been there a month. Who fixes that? I've never known who to call for roads out here.

emails.name: Marilyn Gawronski
emails.body:
When do the winter tax bills come out and when are they due? My escrow changed this year when we refinanced and I want to make sure the bank gets it. Can I pay at the township hall in person?

Marilyn

emails.name: Gail Haley
emails.body:
The rental next to me has had a couch, a broken grill and bags of garbage in the front yard for a MONTH. I called last week and someone said they'd send an inspector. Nothing has changed. What does it take to get this cleaned up?? Property values on our road matter.

Gail Haley

emails.name: Ray Kloska
emails.body:
Supervisor Seidlitz, the Essexville-Hampton Lions Club holds its annual pancake breakfast for the veterans on Saturday, November 7, 7 to 11 a.m., at the Lions hall. We'd be honored if you would come say a few words around 9. Please let me know.

Ray Kloska, secretary
